notes.dhwAgeBand: The homeowner says "two years ago"; the auditor CONFIRMS in his own words ("Yeah, two years, so no concern"). Rule 6 makes this a usable value -> 2 yr -> 0-5. This is the intended contrast with transcript 06, where the auditor refuses the homeowner's age. A model that treats all second-speaker numbers identically will get exactly one of these two wrong.
